D: A teenager raised in Africa starts at a US high school and gets caught up with the popular girls.
P: Serve the snacks when Cady first sees the cafeteria map.
S: Flour tortillas spread with beetroot hummus, filled with roast chicken, rocket and feta, rolled and sliced into pink spirals.

Dark chocolate layered with white chocolate and crushed candy canes, set and snapped into shards, bundled with ribbon-tied candy canes. Line a tray with baking paper. Melt 200g dark chocolate, spread it thin and chill 15 minutes until set. Melt 200g white chocolate with a few drops of peppermint essence and spread over the top. Scatter with 4 crushed candy canes and press in lightly. Chill 30 minutes, then snap into shards. Tie 8 more candy canes in bundles of four with ribbon.

Little shortcrust pies in a muffin tin filled with cinnamon apple, latticed on top, sprinkled with raw sugar and baked golden. Vanilla cream to dollop. Cook 3 diced Granny Smith apples with 30g butter, 3 tbsp brown sugar and 1 tsp cinnamon for 8 minutes until soft, then cool. Cut 12 rounds from 3 sheets shortcrust and press into a greased muffin tin. Fill with apple, cut the leftover pastry into strips and weave a lattice on each. Brush with egg, sprinkle with raw sugar and bake at 190C for 25 minutes. Whip 200ml cream with vanilla.
M: Parmesan and panko crumbed chicken tenders baked crisp, with buttery mash and a crunchy cos salad, ranch dip on the side, served on trays. Cut 700g chicken breast into strips. Dust in flour, dip in 2 beaten eggs and coat in 150g panko mixed with 40g parmesan and paprika. Bake on an oiled tray at 220C for 18 minutes, turning once. Mash 1kg potatoes with 60g butter and milk. Toss a chopped cos lettuce with cucumber and lemon dressing. Mix 150g sour cream, 2 tbsp mayo, dill and chives for ranch.
the Halloween party where everyone dresses up
Beef mince browned hard with onion, garlic, cumin, smoked paprika and a little tomato paste, loosened with stock, spooned into warm hard shells with cheddar, shredded lettuce, tomato and sour cream.
W: Vanilla cupcakes baked at 175C for 18 minutes, cooled, piped with buttercream tinted pale pink with a spoon of raspberry purée, finished with pink sprinkles.
K: Fresh lemon juice blended with raspberries and sugar syrup, strained, topped with cold soda water over ice with lemon wheels and whole berries. Dissolve 150g sugar in 150ml hot water and cool. Blend with the juice of 5 lemons and 125g raspberries, then strain. Pour into a jug with plenty of ice, top with 1L cold soda water and add lemon wheels and a few whole raspberries. Stir and pour into four glasses.

s.how: Blitz a roasted beetroot with a drained tin of chickpeas, tahini, lemon and garlic until pink. Spread on 4 flour tortillas, fill with 300g shredded roast chicken, rocket and 100g feta. Roll tight and slice into spirals. On Wednesdays we wear pink.

Scatter with 4 crushed candy canes and press in lightly. Chill 30 minutes, then snap into shards. Tie 8 more candy canes in bundles of four with ribbon.

m.note: the Halloween party where everyone dresses up
m.how: Brown 600g beef mince hard with an onion, a garlic clove, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp smoked paprika and 1 tbsp tomato paste. Loosen with 150ml stock. Spoon into 12 warm hard shells with cheddar, lettuce, tomato and sour cream.

w.how: Beat 125g butter with 150g sugar, add 2 eggs and fold in 200g self-raising flour and 125ml milk. Bake 12 at 175C for 18 minutes. Beat 150g butter with 300g icing sugar and a spoon of strained raspberry purée until pale pink. Pipe and add pink sprinkles.

d.how: Dissolve 150g sugar in 150ml hot water and cool. Blend with the juice of 5 lemons and 125g raspberries, then strain. Pour into a jug with plenty of ice, top with 1L cold soda water and add lemon wheels and a few whole raspberries. Stir and pour into four glasses.
